target_customer: B2B sales and revenue operations teams that run Salesforce and need to assign inbound leads and contacts to reps
problem: Leads sit unassigned or go to the wrong rep inside Salesforce, which slows speed to lead. Building routing rules in native Salesforce tooling is hard for non-developers.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, a Salesforce-native app (a directory listing shows per user per month pricing, unverified)
product_category: Salesforce lead routing and assignment automation

founders.name: Tanu Venkatesh
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists her as the only founder and gives no background. No opened source states education or prior employers.

competitors.name: LeanData
competitors.what: Lead to account matching and routing for Salesforce, the established vendor in the same wedge
competitors.traction_then: unknown at the time; the source for this entry is dated 2014 and describes the product positioning
competitors.funding_then: 5.1M USD Series A in 2014 per TechCrunch; a later 2019 round reported only by an aggregator and unverified

technical_complexity.rationale: A Salesforce managed package with a visual rule canvas, assignment logic and metrics. Standard engineering on a well documented platform, with some difficulty in handling scale and Salesforce limits.

defensibility.rationale: Routing rules built inside a customer's Salesforce org create mild lock in, but the feature set is copyable and established vendors already offered routing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent acquiring or shutting the company. Salesforce native assignment rules and LeanData remained alternatives, and directory pages list PowerRouter beside them.

market_need_then: Speed to lead and account based sales were common RevOps concerns in 2021, and LeanData had been selling Salesforce lead management since at least 2014, which shows paid demand. No PowerRouter specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses powerrouter.io, not the .com; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: not described by any opened source

brand_strength.rationale: Only directory, review site and Product Hunt listings were found. No press about the brand, no community or merch.

outcome_analysis: PowerRouter is still listed as active and I found no news of an acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Public information is thin: no confirmed funding round, no press coverage and only directory profiles, so its traction cannot be judged. It targets a real but contested wedge against LeanData and native Salesforce tooling, and it has stayed small.
notes: The company website returned HTTP 403 to the fetch, so it was not read. A 125K USD seed dated 2021-03 appears only on aggregator sites (Bouncewatch, Village) and is unverified, so it is not recorded as a round. Founding year conflicts across directories (2016 on some, 2018 role start on another), so it is left null. Revenue and headcount figures on Latka are unverified. LeanData's 2019 round is aggregator only. Other competitors named on review sites (LeadAngel, Chili Piper) lack dated sources from the batch period.
